prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a precise low resolution pixel art SPRITE SHEET, transparent background, NO text NO grid lines. Use the two viewed images as identity references: brown spiky-haired navy-coated archer with white coat trim, brown diagonal harness and quiver; white spiky-haired officer wearing black long coat with gold epaulettes and piping and brown boots. Change proportions to slender THREE HEADS TALL: head including hair exactly one third of full height, narrow shoulders, longer torso and legs. Authentic coarse low resolution 48 pixel tall characters, crisp single-pixel outline, only 3-4 shade bands per material, no antialiasing, no painterly details. The whole sheet is FIVE EQUAL COLUMNS and THREE EQUAL ROWS. Every cell equal, every figure same scale, fully separated and whole body with generous transparent margins, feet baseline consistent. Row 1: archer BACK VIEW idle, then back walking four frames alternating left/right leg and opposite arm. Row 2: archer BACK VIEW aiming toward upper right, bow shooting four frames: raise bow, half draw, full draw, released string follow through; fifth cell EMPTY. Row 3: officer BACK idle, then FOUR left-facing SIDE RUNNING frames with opposite arm/leg alternation. Additionally officer FRONT idle: place in row2 column5 (the otherwise empty cell). Keep same people, hair silhouette, equipment and colors from reference. Do not enlarge the heads. Sprite body height 48 conceptual pixels with head 16 torso 16 legs 16. Transparent background.

Create a sprite atlas of TWO ORIGINAL game characters from the previously viewed reference sprites, maintaining identities and clothes. EXACTLY 5 columns x 3 rows, no text, no lines. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background, absolutely NO backdrop, shadows, glow or gradient. STRICT COARSE PIXEL ART: draw each human as ONLY 48 PIXELS TALL in conceptual resolution, HEAD INCLUDING HAIR exactly 16 pixels tall, torso 16 pixels, legs+boots 16 pixels. Thus 3 heads tall, medium-large heads but not chibi. One-pixel thick dark outline, only 3 shades per material, pixel clusters and solid square pixels, no fine detail, no dithering. Each figure centered in identical spacious cell. Brown spiky-haired archer navy coat white edging brown harness quiver bow; white tousled spiky-haired young officer black coat gold epaulettes/trim brown boots. Archer HAIR same swept spiky brown shape and officer same white sweep and blue eyes as original. Frame layout: top row archer back idle then back WALK four distinct alternating strides; middle row archer BACK THREE-QUARTER bow raising, bow half draw, bow FULL draw (right hand pulled near cheek, curved bow visibly bent), release (hand recoils, string relaxed), then officer FRONT IDLE. Bottom row officer BACK IDLE then officer LEFT-FACING RUN four frames with clearly opposite arms and legs alternating. Head proportions uniform ALL frames. Archer white coat hem ends at upper thigh, not ankle. Officer hem upper thigh. Officer arms bare hands, no black gloves. Do not make photorealistic, tall realistically proportioned soldiers. Aim for compact classic 16-bit RPG three-head-tall sprites. transparent background.

Use case: identity-preserve. Reference is the attached generated atlas, reference ONLY the white-haired officer in its bottom row. Create a NEW single strip of FOUR EQUAL CELLS with this same officer RUNNING LEFT in strict coarse pixel art 3 heads tall (head including hair 16 conceptual pixels; whole person 48 pixels high). Transparent background. Black coat gold epaulettes/trim, brown boots, white tousled hair, bare hands. All four faces must look LEFT in profile. Critical opposite limb phase: frame1 NEAR ARM forward with fist at left of chest, NEAR LEG BACK to right; frame2 NEAR ARM DOWN at waist with fist right of torso, NEAR LEG FORWARD left; frame3 NEAR ARM BACK fully to right and FAR ARM FORWARD at left of chest, NEAR LEG FORWARD left; frame4 NEAR ARM returning forward, NEAR LEG BACK right. Make the visible nearer gold epaulette and sleeve physically move with shoulder so frames 1 and 3 have clearly opposing arms. Legs must alternate and not all point same way. Same scale and hair size every cell, 1 pixel outline and 3 shades per material, NO soft painting NO ground/shadows NO text. Keep 3-head proportions of reference white-haired back idle.
selection: 첫 생성은 비율 불일치로 제외. 두 번째 생성에서 궁수와 정적 주인공 채택. 달리기는 세 번째 생성에서 검토 후 채택.
